title: Fortnite and Roblox
text: Fortnite and Roblox are two of the most popular games in the world. Both are free, and millions of children and teenagers play them every day. But they are very different.

Fortnite came out in 2017. Its most famous mode is Battle Royale: one hundred players jump from a flying bus onto an island. They look for weapons and build walls. The last player alive is the winner. The game was so popular that its dances were everywhere.

Roblox is older. It was created in 2004 and it opened to everyone in 2006. Roblox is not really one game: it is a platform with millions of games. The players were the creators. Anyone could make a game, like BEAR (Alpha).

Both games make money in a similar way. They are free, but players can buy things for their characters, like skins or emotes. In Fortnite the money is called V-Bucks, and in Roblox it is called Robux.

Both games also became places to meet. There were concerts inside Fortnite, and some schools used Roblox for lessons. For many young people, these games were not only games: they were their social network.

grammar.title: Grammar: was / were
grammar.rule: Was and were are the past of the verb to be. Use was with I, he, she and it, and were with you, we and they.
items: I ___ at the concert last year.
